veg.name: Standard Veg Thali (R.D.S.B)
veg.description: Complete homestyle comfort thali featuring Steamed Basmati Rice, 4 fresh whole-wheat Chapatis, comforting Dal Fry, seasonal Vegetable Sabzi, crispy Aloo Bhujia, green salad, and mango pickle.

veg.name: Premium Paneer Thali
veg.description: Rich vegetarian feast including Shahi Paneer or Kadai Paneer, aromatic Jeera Rice, 4 butter-brushed Chapatis, Dal Tadka, Crispy Bhujia, Veg Raita, Salad, Papad, and sweet Gulab Jamun.

veg.name: Dehati Dal Bhaat Chokha
veg.description: The ultimate cultural comfort food of Jharkhand. Traditional Arhar Dal with desi ghee tadka, steamed Arwa Rice, roasted Potato & Baingan Chokha with mustard oil, green chilies, papad, and chutney.

veg.name: Royal Veg Dum Biryani
veg.description: Fragrant long-grain aged basmati rice layered with spiced paneer cubes, green peas, carrots, and saffron, served with chilled cucumber-mint raita and salan.

veg.name: Breakfast Special Plate
veg.description: Fresh morning breakfast: Puri Sabji, Stuffed Paratha with Curd, South Indian Idli Sambar, Khasta Kachori, Chole Bhature, or Jharkhand Famous Dhuska with Ghugni.

non_veg.name: Dehati Chicken Curry Thali
non_veg.description: Ranchi style slow-cooked spicy chicken curry (3 pieces) made with authentic local whole spices, served with fresh Basmati Rice or 4 Chapatis, Dal Fry, crispy bhujia, salad, and pickle.

non_veg.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
non_veg.description: Aromatic dum-cooked basmati biryani with marinated tender chicken pieces, caramelized onions, mint, and saffron, accompanied by spiced cucumber raita and rich salan.

non_veg.name: Ranchi Rohu Fish Curry Thali
non_veg.description: Fresh Rohu fish (2 pieces) prepared in traditional Jharkhand mustard-garlic-tomato gravy, served with hot steamed rice, crispy bhujia, lemon, sliced onions, and papad.

non_veg.name: Homestyle Egg Curry Thali
non_veg.description: Two pan-fried hard-boiled eggs simmered in rich tomato-onion gravy, served alongside steamed Basmati Rice, 4 wheat rotis, dal fry, crispy bhujia, and green salad.
